content_harvesting.sublines: Typed JSON Intent Contracts for On-Device Gemma at 11,000 Feet
talking_points: Prompt templates inject current node ID and local mountain time into a closed 8-field JSON contract for Gemma 2B/4B.
Pydantic validation strips fenced LLM output, enforces closed enums for difficulty, service speed, and POI categories, and falls back to safe defaults on malformed JSON.
Mock and custom callback modes run in under 0.1 ms locally with zero external network calls.
